_comment: Vendored community skills. Each entry is pinned to a commit and copied verbatim (plus its LICENSE) by scripts/sync_community.py. Only MIT / Apache-2.0 sources. Vendored files are knowledge: they are NOT registered as plugin skills (they live outside skills/), and the ads-community umbrella skill routes to them. The write gate applies no matter which skill is loaded.

sources.role: Meta delivery-system mechanics: breakdown effect, learning phase, auction overlap, pacing, relevance diagnostics, performance fluctuations.
Broad paid-ads playbooks (Meta decision system, Google Search, LinkedIn B2B, audit guardrails), ad creative systems, attribution models, conversion tracking with GTM recipes, A/B test sizing.
Platform-expansion layer: audit checklists and creative specs for TikTok, LinkedIn, Microsoft, YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, X, Amazon, Apple; compliance; benchmarks; industry plan templates.

Sixteen ad-creative skills: five write copy (hooks, primary text, search headlines, offer/proof lines, funnel variants), eleven judge it (fatigue read, test readout, early-signal cut, losing-ad diagnosis, winner teardown, claim safety, ad-to-landing match).
Google Ads analysis, audit and math. (Its write and MCP skills are intentionally not vendored: Google writes go through this plugin's gated writer.)
Pre-flight ad policy check and claims gate (substantiation of every claim before it ships).
Meta Marketing API write discipline: rate limits, error codes, write rules that avoid integrity flags.
